text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. Ayan Kailie, Justine Montgomery and Nick Setacci are reappointment. Elaine Stanley is a new appointment. These four candidates will fill the four vacant positions. Andrea Beitel will not be returning to the Board. Her term ends on May 16, 2024.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following individuals to the Swansea Town Hall Board of Management at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending May 31, 2026 and until successors are appointed: -Ayan Kailie; -Justine Montgomery; -Nick Setacci; and -Elaine Stanley.
